construction_markdown:
Let `p(Z)=Z^16+Z^5+Z^3+Z^2+1` and `F=F_2[Z]/(p)`, with `alpha=Z mod p`. Write each `a in F` uniquely as `a=sum_{i=0}^{15} a_i alpha^i`.

Let `A=span_{F_2}{1,alpha,...,alpha^14}`, ordered by the binary integer represented by its 15 coefficients. Thus `|A|=32768`. Define the outer code by evaluating every `f in F[X]` of degree at most 64 on `A`.

For `a=sum a_i alpha^i`, define the inner word

`H(a)=(a_0+sum_{i=1}^{15} a_i y_i)_{y in F_2^15}`,

with `y` in binary-integer order. Finally set

`C={(H(f(x)))_{x in A}: f in F[X], deg(f)<=64}`,

with the blocks flattened in the specified order. This is a symbolic deterministic encoder with no shortening, puncturing, padding, sampling, or hidden finite choice.

discussion_posts.body_markdown: Let `V=F_2^m` for `(m,d*)=(16,8185),(17,8184),(18,8184)`. Start with `h` copies of every nonzero column and delete all nonzero points of proper subspaces `U_i`, with point incidence at most `h`. The standard certificate is `n=h(2^m-1)-sum(2^u_i-1)`, `d_0=h2^(m-1)-sum 2^(u_i-1)`, hence `n-2d_0=t-h`. Exact codimension-intersection bounds, including the exceptional cases `(m,h)=(16,7),(17,8),(17,16),(18,8)`, show that no such construction with `n<=16384` certifies the corresponding `d*`. Thus whole-subspace Solomon–Stiffler deletion cannot supply any of the three surviving `2^14` RS inner gateways.

discussion_posts.body_markdown: For fixed-pole rational trace codes on all `q=2^30` affine points, assume every nonconstant reduced phase has a rational odd-order pole at infinity and only nonrational finite poles. With `R=sum_P(d_P+1)deg(P)`, reduced principal parts give `k<=1+15R`, while the Artin–Schreier genus formula and Hasse–Weil give `|S(f)|<=(R-2)2^15`. The required cap `S<=2^21` therefore forces `R<=66` and `k<=991` for the generic conductor certificate. Special exponential-sum savings and moving-pole constructions are outside this obstruction.

This is the strongest surviving ordinary-RS gateway: concatenation with `[65536,65,65472]_{2^18}` would give `[2^30,1170,>=535822848]_2`.

distance_audit: A nonzero polynomial of degree at most 64 has at most 64 roots among the 32768 distinct elements of `A`, so at least 32704 outer symbols are nonzero.

`H(1)` is the all-one word of weight 32768. Every `H(a)` with `a notin {0,1}` is a nonconstant affine truth table and has weight exactly 16384. Thus every nonzero inner symbol contributes at least 16384.
Every nonzero concatenated word therefore has weight at least `32704*16384=535822336`.

The bound is attained: prescribe 64 roots, form their monic root polynomial `g`, and choose the first `z in F*` outside `g(A\R)`. Then `z^(-1)g` has 64 zero evaluations and no evaluation equal to 1, so precisely 32704 balanced inner blocks occur.
The exact target identity is `535822336=2^29-2^20=(1/2-2^-10)2^30`; equivalently the allowed one-sided signed imbalance is `2^30-2D=2^21`.
The strongest conditional gateway has product distance `8184*65472=535822848=D+512`, but no required inner code is presently proved.
explicitness_audit: The field modulus is explicit. Repeated squaring gives `Z^(2^8)=Z^8+Z^7+Z^3+Z` and `Z^(2^16)=Z mod p`; Euclidean reduction gives `gcd(p,Z^(2^8)+Z)=1`, certifying irreducibility.
The polynomial basis, evaluation subset, evaluation order, inner-coordinate order, block order, and all 65 field-valued message coefficients are specified.
The final length is obtained directly as `32768*32768`; no length adjustment is used.
No random choice or numerical search defines the encoder. The auxiliary scalar used only to witness exact distance is selected by the stated finite field order.

The transient conditional-average `k=2971` proposal is not used: each generator bit is chosen by exhaustive comparison over all completions, which is the numerical/exhaustive witness search excluded by the contribution guide. Without a compact structural evaluator, accepting it would turn probabilistic existence into an ostensibly explicit construction by lexicographic search.

The workspace was read-only, so the inline proof could not be persisted under `proofs/` or added to `data/records.json`. The data validator was attempted but `node` is unavailable; persistence, validation, and dashboard rebuilding remain publication tasks.

proof_markdown:
### Theorem

The displayed construction is a deterministic binary linear code with exact parameters

`[1,073,741,824,1040,535,822,336]_2`.

Its rate is `1040/2^30=65/2^26`.

### Field certificate

For `p(Z)=Z^16+Z^5+Z^3+Z^2+1`, repeated squaring modulo `p` gives

`Z^(2^8)=Z^8+Z^7+Z^3+Z` and `Z^(2^16)=Z`.

Euclidean division of `p` and `Z^(2^8)+Z` terminates with nonzero remainders `Z^2+1` and `1`. Since 2 is the only prime divisor of 16, the degree-16 Rabin criterion proves that `p` is irreducible. Hence `F` is the explicitly represented field of order `2^16`.

### Linearity, length, and dimension

The outer message space `F[X]_{<=64}` has dimension 65 over `F`. Evaluation on `A` is `F`-linear and injective: a nonzero polynomial of degree at most 64 cannot vanish at all 32768 distinct evaluation points.

The map `H` is `F_2`-linear. Its value at `y=0` recovers `a_0`, and its values at the 15 unit vectors then recover `a_1,...,a_15`; hence it is injective. The composite encoder is therefore binary linear and injective, with dimension `16*65=1040`. It has `2^15` blocks of length `2^15`, so its exact length is `2^30`.

### Minimum distance

For a nonzero message polynomial, let `r` be the number of evaluations equal to zero and `s` the number equal to one. Then `r<=64`. The block `H(1)` has weight `2^15`, while every other nonzero block is a balanced nonconstant affine function of weight `2^14`. Consequently

`wt(C(f))=2^14(32768-r+s)>=2^14(32768-64)=535822336`.

For equality, take the monic product `g` of the factors corresponding to the first 64 points of `A`. Its nonroot image has at most 32704 elements, fewer than the 65535 elements of `F*`. Choose the first `z in F*` outside that image and put `f=z^(-1)g`. Then `f` has exactly 64 zero evaluations and no evaluation equal to one. Hence all its remaining 32704 blocks have weight `2^14`, proving that the lower bound is attained.

### Ancillary hybrid ceilings

For a fixed reduced Artin–Schreier pole divisor, put `R=sum_P(d_P+1)deg(P)`. Removing even Laurent orders modulo `h^2+h` leaves at most `(d_P+1)/2` residue-field coefficients at each pole, so the binary phase-space dimension is at most `1+15R`. Riemann–Hurwitz gives `2g<=R-2`; with the stated infinity-pole convention the affine signed sum equals `#C(F_q)-q-1`, and Hasse–Weil gives `|S|<=(R-2)2^15`. Thus the generic target certificate requires `R<=66` and gives dimension at most 991.

For a simple PDS connection set of size `k_0=2^30` in `F_2^K`, the strongly regular identity is `(v-k_0-1)mu=k_0(k_0-lambda-1)`, where `v=2^K`. If `mu>=1`, then `v<=k_0^2+1`, hence `K<=60`. If `mu=0`, the Cayley components would be cliques of order `k_0+1=2^30+1`, impossible for a subgroup of an elementary abelian 2-group.

Finally, for standard `h`-copy simplex deletion by whole proper subspaces, the certified parameters satisfy `n=h(2^m-1)-sum(2^u_i-1)`, `d_0=h2^(m-1)-sum 2^(u_i-1)`, and `n-2d_0=t-h`. Codimension intersection bounds reduce the three surviving inner targets to four exceptional `(m,h)` pairs. Exact power-of-two accounting eliminates `(16,7)`, `(17,8)`, `(17,16)`, and `(18,8)` as detailed in proof step `SS-GATEWAYS`. Thus this standard certificate cannot realize any surviving gateway, although arbitrary inner codes remain open.

proof_steps.proof: The displayed Frobenius congruences and terminal Euclidean remainder 1 satisfy the degree-16 Rabin irreducibility criterion.
Evaluation of 65-coefficient polynomials is injective on 32768 distinct points, and the degree-64 root bound gives distance 32704.
proof_steps.statement: The outer evaluation code has exact parameters `[32768,65,32704]_{2^16}`.

proof_steps.proof: Coefficient recovery proves injectivity; nonconstant affine functions are balanced and the sole nonzero constant has full weight.
proof_steps.statement: `H(F)` is a binary `[32768,16,16384]` affine Reed–Muller code.

proof_steps.proof: The coordinatewise composite of the two injective binary-linear maps has length `32768^2` and dimension `65*16`.
proof_steps.statement: `C` is binary linear of exact length `2^30` and dimension 1040.

proof_steps.proof: At least 32704 outer symbols are nonzero, and each contributes at least 16384 ones.
proof_steps.statement: Every nonzero codeword has weight at least 535822336.

proof_steps.proof: A polynomial with 64 prescribed roots can be scaled by an omitted nonzero image value so that every remaining symbol avoids 1 and hence has balanced inner weight.

Parity extension gives length 32769 and distances on the lattice `t congruent 1 mod 4`, `t<=5`. The polynomial `(t-5)(t+5459)(t+5463)=208626588K_0+29866212K_1+21834K_2+6K_3` is nonpositive there. Delsarte gives cardinality at most 229528, below `2^18`.
proof_steps.statement: No binary code of length 32768, cardinality `2^18`, and distance at least 16381 exists.

proof_steps.proof: Reduced principal-part counting gives `k<=1+15R`; the Artin–Schreier genus formula and Hasse–Weil give `|S|<=(R-2)2^15`. The target therefore requires `R<=66`.
proof_steps.statement: Generic fixed-conductor Artin–Schreier certification at this target has dimension at most 991.

proof_steps.proof: The strongly regular parameter identity gives `2^K<=2^60+1` when `mu>0`; `mu=0` would require a Cayley component of impossible order `2^30+1`.
proof_steps.statement: Simple unweighted PDS/Cayley character codes of target length have ambient dimension at most 60.

proof_steps.proof: For each target, `n-2d_0=t-h` bounds the number of deleted subspaces. If more than `h` deletion subspaces have codimension at most `j` with `j(h+1)<m`, their intersection contains a nonzero point deleted more than `h` times. Exact capacity bounds eliminate all `h` except `(m,h)=(16,7),(17,8),(17,16),(18,8)`. For `(16,7)`, the equations force 7 hyperplanes and 14 remaining powers of two whose deficit from `14*8192` would have to equal 8185, impossible. For `(17,8)` and `(18,8)`, they force 8 hyperplanes and 16 remaining powers whose deficit from their maximum would be 8184, smaller than one permitted downgrade. For `(17,16)`, the required deleted-weight sum forces all 32 subspaces to be hyperplanes, which would make `d_0=0`.
proof_steps.statement: The standard whole-subspace `h`-copy simplex-deletion certificate cannot realize any of the three surviving `2^14` inner gateways.

proof_steps.proof: If a deterministic `[16384,18,8184]_2` code exists, concatenate it with the explicit full-length `[65536,65,65472]_{2^18}` Reed–Solomon code. Length, dimension, and product distance become `2^30`, 1170, and 535822848. Current parity-LP bounds force the residual chain but do not prove the inner code's existence.
proof_steps.statement: A deterministic `[16384,18,8184]_2` inner code would yield a target code of dimension 1170.
